s.n: Enjoy the little things mini corn dogs
s.note: Cocktail franks in sweet corn batter, fried on sticks.
s.how: Pat the franks dry and push a skewer into each. Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, salt, egg and milk into a thick batter and pour it into a tall glass. Dip each frank in the batter and fry in oil at 180C, turning, until deep golden. Drain and serve with mustard and tomato sauce.

s.note: Twice-baked potato skins with bacon and cheddar.
s.how: Rub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200C until tender. Fry the bacon until crisp. Halve the potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh and save it for mash. Fill the skins with bacon and cheddar and bake again until crisp and melted. Top with sour cream and spring onion.

m.note: Two smashed beef patties and American cheese. It all started with mad cow disease.
m.how: Roll the mince into 8 balls and stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard together. Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add a ball with some onion on top and smash it flat with a spatula. Cook until the edges crisp, flip, add cheese and stack two patties per burger. Toast the buns, spread with sauce and build with the patties and pickles.

m.note: Turkey, bacon and tomato in toasted triple decks. Bill Murray's one regret: Garfield, maybe.
m.how: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp. Fry the bacon until crisp. Toast the bread and spread each slice with mayonnaise. Layer turkey, lettuce, bacon and tomato over three slices per sandwich. Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with the fries.

w.n: Deep-fried Twinkies with vanilla ice cream
w.note: Battered hot and dusted with icing sugar, with vanilla ice cream.
w.how: Whisk the flour, egg and milk into a smooth batter. Skewer the frozen Twinkies and dip them in the batter. Fry at 180C for 2 to 3 minutes until golden, then drain. Dust with icing sugar and serve with ice cream.

d.n: Nut up or shut up peanut butter shakes
d.note: Peanut butter and banana blended thick with vanilla ice cream.
d.how: Blend the banana, peanut butter, ice cream and milk until thick. Swirl chocolate topping round 4 glasses and pour in the shakes.
